changes.title: Beach edge
items: The woods now meet the beach in a scalloped edge of bushes, beach grass and the odd palm, with soft shade on the sand under them, instead of a grainy band

changes.title: Beach decor
items: The beach is more irregular: wide sandy bays, narrow stretches, and rocky ones where the sand nearly vanishes
Shells, starfish, the odd conch and washed-up seaweed lie about the sand, and trails of footprints (bare feet, paws, hooves, birds) wander along it and fade away

changes.title: Straight to bedroom
items: The game opens straight into her bedroom: no title card first. The controls, What's new and the options are tabs in the room (press ? for the controls)
The party spell's scroll stays rolled up while the forest grows (the fairy lights are the loading bar), then unrolls when it's ready
WASD keys on her bedroom floor show how to walk: the one you press lights up, and they fade once she's walking (arrows if you use the arrows)
